ai_summary: ABINFRABUILD LIMITED reports robust growth, with Q1 FY27 total income up 25.9% and a strong historical revenue CAGR of 41% (FY22-FY26), underpinned by substantial government infrastructure investment and a healthy order book in railway and road construction. The company has effectively expanded its EBITDA margins and invested in assets to support future projects. A key concern, however, is the significantly lower Q1 FY27 net profit growth of 4.3% compared to revenue and EBITDA, suggesting rising non-operating expenses or taxes that warrant further detailed financial analysis.
